response.justification: Technically a strong, versatile senior engineer with 15+ years across web, embedded, low-latency systems, plus genuine open-source credibility (GISCollective, D ecosystem libraries, FOSS4G talk) and Linux/DevOps exposure — all relevant to an open-source, digital-sovereignty consultancy. However, the role is an executive-level leadership position and the resume shows no formal people leadership, team management, or technical project management experience; mentoring appears only via workshops and community teaching. Two hard requirements are unmet: German at C1 minimum (listed as 'Basic') and demonstrable IT architecture/UML modeling, requirements management, and security/compliance ownership. Python is also absent from the skill set. Absent evidence of German fluency progression or a leadership track record, this is a mismatch for a Head of Development, though a strong candidate for a senior/staff IC role.
strengths: Deep, broad 15+ year engineering track record across many stacks and domains
Authentic open-source and Linux/DevOps background, incl. founding an OSS geo platform
Proven knowledge-sharing: workshops, courses, conference talks (mentoring potential)
concerns: German listed as 'Basic' vs. required C1 — likely disqualifying for client advisory
No formal team leadership, people management, or project-management experience
No evidence of UML/architecture design, requirements management, or IT security/compliance work

key_factors.factor: Strong open-source, Linux, and senior engineering depth
